title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
key_facts: Nous Research, maker of the open-source Hermes Agent, confirmed a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation, confirming TechCrunch's earlier reporting.
The round was led by Robot Ventures, with Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures and Samsung among other backers.
Total funding is now $158 million; the company is three years old.
Hermes Agent has been cloned more than 24 million times and drives roughly 2.5% of global AI token usage (company estimates).
'Hermes for Businesses' will let companies deploy customised AI agents for multi-step workflows while keeping data private (company plan).
The Wall Street Journal reports about $36 million annualised revenue by mid-September 2026, expecting more than $100 million before the end of 2026.
quote_evidence: Nous was at roughly $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million before the end of 2026, The Wall Street Journal reported.

The capital will fund Nous Research’s push into the enterprise sector with “Hermes for Businesses,” allowing companies to deploy customized AI agents that can handle multi-step workflows while keeping their data private and secure.
why_it_matters_hint: A popular open-source AI agent is turning into a paid business; usage figures are company estimates.
event_date: 7 Oct 2026 (company confirmation); the round's own date is not stated
notes: Full article read (TechCrunch). Investor list shortened in the entry. TechCrunch first reported the round earlier; that earlier date is not in the article or the pool, so the item is kept NEW.
